name: Pride
source:
God and creator of Limbo, Father Pride watches over the peace and well-being of his realm, but the life of a god can be solitary. When he welcomes you with open arms, his kindness draws you in...and a perturbing omen makes you stay.

[From [url=https://ravenstar-games.itch.io/lost-in-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
